data.summary: Read-only endpoint that returns a customer's accounts (savings, checking, credit) with balances and status. Third parties must request the accounts:read scope.
data.description: Provides a list of accounts owned by an authenticated customer. Supports pagination and optional filters (type, status).

data.summary: Billing & statement API - returns recurring charges, invoices, and scheduled bill payments for a customer.
data.description: Used by authorized third parties to retrieve billing events and scheduled mandates for the customer (e.g., subscriptions, EMI schedules).

data.summary: Create and query customer-initiated payments. Requires explicit user consent and payments:write or payments:read scopes.
data.description: Endpoint to create a payment instruction (IMPS/NEFT/RTGS/UPI) on behalf of an authenticated customer and to query payment status.

data.summary: Return a list of transactions (debits/credits) for a given account. Supports filtering by date, amount, and merchant.
data.description: Transactions endpoint returns ledger entries for an account. Useful for reconciliation, categorization, and statement generation.
